title: Handling Added to a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee for the Route the Item Came Back On
content:
The handling the route back cost is then added. Where the service the item was delivered on schedules a two person crew and offers no slot on the day of the order, the crew handling amount is added. Where that service schedules no two person crew and offers no slot on the day of the order, the parcel handling amount is added. In any other case nothing is added.

The crew handling amount is 35.00 USD. The parcel handling amount is 12.00 USD.

## What is read

The service read is the fulfilment service recorded for that item on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment. Two things about it decide the addition to the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee: whether it schedules a two person crew, and the shortest lead it publishes. A service whose shortest lead is 1 day or more offers no slot on the day of the order; a service whose shortest lead is nothing offers one.

| Does the delivering service schedule a two person crew? | Its shortest lead | Amount added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 1 day or more | 35.00 USD |
| no | 1 day or more | 12.00 USD |
| yes | nothing | nothing |
| no | nothing | nothing |

Both conditions are compound: a two person crew on a service that does offer a slot on the day of the order adds nothing, and so does a service with a lead but no crew recorded where no crew is scheduled and no lead is published.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*An appliance delivered on a service scheduling a two person crew whose shortest lead is 4 days.* Both parts of the first condition hold, and 35.00 USD is added.

*A television delivered on a service scheduling no two person crew whose shortest lead is 2 days.* The second condition holds, and 12.00 USD is added.

*A small item delivered on a service scheduling a two person crew that offers same-day collection, its shortest lead standing at nothing.* Neither condition holds, and nothing is added.

*An item for which no delivering service is recorded at all.* Nothing read comes to 1 day or more, so nothing is added.
